command.help:
Comenzi Gatehouse:
/gatehouse list [pending|resolving|approved|denied|blocked]
/gatehouse show <id-cerere|username>
/gatehouse approve|deny|block|undo <id-cerere|username> [motiv...]
/gatehouse unblock <username> [motiv...]
/gatehouse status
/gatehouse reload
command.list_truncated: Sunt afisate cele mai recente 50 de cereri actualizate. Restrange lista cu /gatehouse list <status>.
